changes.b: NSF Engineering consolidated its core programs
changes.t: ECCS (NSF 26-514), CMMI (26-515) and CBET (26-518) now accept proposals anytime, alongside the MPS materials solicitation (26-521).
Under NSF 26-521, from Oct 1 each year a person can be PI or co-PI on only one proposal per fiscal year across all eight materials programs.

changes.b: DOE Office of Science FY2027 open call
changes.t: Many BES materials and chemical-sciences programs encourage white papers or pre-applications by Nov 30, 2026 under the FY2027 call (DE-FOA-0003665). ASCR requires pre-applications by Nov 22, 2026 for its analog-computing panel and by Jan 10, 2027 for its quantum-routing panel.

NIST's CHIPS R&D Office paused white-paper intake on Sep 15, 2026 and expects to reopen in November. DARPA's Microsystems Technology Office is now the Multi X Office (MXO), with a new office-wide solicitation.
FuSe2, ExpandQISE and QuSeC-TAQS are archived; MRSEC, DMREF, ERC and NRT are between competitions. MRI is waiting for a new solicitation.
NIH now accepts at most 6 applications per PI per calendar year, and institutes no longer use paylines.

The President's FY2027 request would cut NSF by 55% and the DOE Office of Science by 13%. Congress has not passed full-year FY2027 funding; a continuing resolution (P.L. 119-103) funds both agencies at about FY2026 levels through Dec 11, 2026.
